descriptions.notStarted: #b#p2101012##k lives outside #b#m260000000##k. He claims to be a member of the Sand Bandits, the secret organization in #m260000000#. If he's a Sand Bandit, then there's got to be a lot of things he should do for these good people. What else is there for me to do?
descriptions.inProgress: #p2101012# told me he'll need a poisoned needle to steal a treasure from the queen, and asked me to get #b#t4000330##k for him. Since this is for the Sand Bandits, this shouldn't be too hard to do. \n\n#i4000330# #t4000330#  #b#c4000330##k/50
descriptions.completed: I gave #p2101012# all the #t4000330#s required for this. Sand Bandits must be needing a lot of stuff to do good for these people.
